description:
FILED s448p (agent P) from the #527 probes; PRE-EXISTING (it predates #527 --
the outer group has exactly ONE child, so it satisfied the OLD
_is_paren_scalar_base too), and #527's fix does not reach it.

REPRO (perl vs ./runpcl):
  my $h = {k=>"HK"};
  print "nested=", ( (0,$h) )->{k}, "\n";     # perl: HK   PCL: dies

  PCL emits   (p-gethash-deref (vector 0 $h) "k")
  where the depth-1 spelling `(0,$h)->{k}` correctly emits
              (p-gethash-deref (progn 0 $h) "k")

CAUSE (located): Pl::ExprToCL::_gen_scalar_deref_base_form sets SCALAR_CTX on
the BASE node and lowers it, but a base that is itself a single-child paren
layer emits its child in whatever context THAT child carries -- gen_progn_form
only pushes context DOWN when its own ctx is LIST_CTX
(`$self->expr_o->set_node_context($_, 1) for @$kids` -- there is no scalar
counterpart), and a single-child tree_val collapses to its child's form.  So
the inner multi-element group still lowers as `(vector ...)`.

SCOPE: all four members of the paren-scalar-base family (`->[i]`, `->{k}`,
`->(...)`, `->method`), and any depth of nesting.  The single-child inner case
(`((0))->[...]`-style) is harmless because a one-element vector and a progn
agree; only a MULTI-element inner group diverges, and then it is a death
(`->{k}`/`->(`/`->method`) or a silent wrong (`->[i]` indexes the vector).

FIX SHAPE (not designed): the scalar context must propagate through
transparent paren layers, i.e. gen_progn_form / gen_tree_val_form need the
SCALAR_CTX counterpart of the LIST_CTX push-down, applied to the LAST child
only (perl's comma operator evaluates the earlier ones for side effects and
takes the last).  That is a context-propagation change in the two most-used
emitters, so it needs its own corpus-diff + emission-ab over the four
populations with every diff read -- do NOT fold it into a filler.

BAR: the four family shapes at one level of nesting + at two + the depth-1
spellings unchanged (Pl/t/anon-sub-01.t's #527 rows) + the LIST SLICE
`((1,2,3))[1]` unchanged + side-effect ordering; guard rows beside the #527
family in Pl/t/anon-sub-01.t.


DONE s451y (Opus, round 10 agent Y), commit 963f5c5.  ONE predicate ExprToCL::_scalar_ctx_pushdown + the SCALAR arm in gen_progn_form and both branches of gen_tree_val_form, LAST CHILD ONLY.  DO NOT RETRY the obvious version: keying the push-down on get_node_context (which DEFAULTS to SCALAR_CTX for an unannotated node) forces scalar onto nodes nobody annotated and moved three unrelated corpus files -- the licence must be an EXPLICIT annotation, i.e. get_node_context_raw.  13 probes vs perl; corpus-diff 3 of 111 (do.t / multideref.t / sub.t, all verdict-neutral: 65/3, 42/10, 62/2 = the blessed baseline); 1007-file A/B DIFF 9, every one the same missing push-down in perl's own t/ (op+uni/universal.t, op/gmagic.t, op/sub_lval.t, re/pat.t, porting/podcheck.t).  Guard Pl/t/anon-sub-01.t 54 -> 59.
